facts.business: Bombay Potteries and Tiles Limited is evaluating strategic options for new construction projects while having recommenced business operations after a period of accumulated losses and negative net worth.

auditor.name: M/s JPKD & Co LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Assessment of Going Concern due to accumulated losses, negative net worth, and operations not yet stabilized; management has not recognized Deferred Tax Assets due to absence of convincing evidence of future taxable profits.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and negative net worth
Operations not yet stabilized after recommencement
Substantial financial resources required for capital-intensive construction projects
Prolonged subdued activity in construction industry
Absence of convincing evidence of future taxable profits leading to non-recognition of Deferred Tax Assets
